messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Problem setting up annotation files
parts:
Hi,

you have not setup your annotationData/ directory correctly. Please
see thread 'problems with annotation file directory path' on Feb 5,
2008 [http://tinyurl.com/6gbttl] in the aroma.affymetrix mailing list
archive. It shows you how to troubleshoot.

/Henrik
